notes: Parts 31-35: 50 groups, 44 rows. Merged groups (one row each, per rule 3): "accel leads 30m series" into "se3"; "ex h" into "remanence"; "mediintech" into "medintech" (Dealroom headline says $25.3M, Wowtale $25.7M); "danish" into "sumary"; "bharat semis usd 24" and "indian semiconductor startup" into "bharat semi"; "with 23m in funding" into "luminal" (SiliconANGLE reports $23M, all other outlets $25M; $25M kept). Round-up expanded: "danish biotech" held two unrelated EUR 20M rounds (Biograil, Traitomic), one row each. "mass general brigham spin off" is kept as its own low-confidence row marked duplicate: same day, amount, seed stage and Boston base as Aevius, but the link could not be confirmed, so it was not merged. Non-rounds marked: St. Augustine, Anaergia, Stereotaxis (public-company debt); Proximal Ventures, Kansas City Regional Housing Fund (fund); 11th St. Workshop / o15 Capital (acquisition financing); University of Tennessee, Air Space Intelligence, Hardwick Tactical, P3 Health Partners (not-funding). EUR converted at 1.11 (rate implied by SE3 coverage) except Orakl, where publishers give $34M. 25 web lookups used (14 searches, 11 fetches; non-candidate URLs in source_urls are pages those lookups surfaced): Tendrils (TFN article; search for UK/seed), Kindo (Pulse 2.0; search for Los Angeles dateline), Remanence (TFN), Arcanus (GlobeNewswire copy), Intergrid (TFN), Luminal (TFN), Luminoah (Pulse 2.0), Fairly (GeekWire 403; two searches found only the Portland base), XpertDox (Pulse 2.0: Scottsdale), Orakl Oncology, Andromeda Robotics (search plus RuntimeWire), NeuxMind.AI (two searches, nothing found), Codex (two searches, round not found), Bedrock Energy (search plus Ventureburn), Aevius (two searches) and the Mass General Brigham headline (one search). Investors reported by lookups without a verbatim span were left out: Orakl co-leads Norrsken VC and Singular; Tendrils FR8, Antimatter, Cloudberry, Conviction, Embassy Ventures, SV Angels; Kindo Marlinspike Partners, New Era Ventures, Sunset Venture; Remanence Zero Prime, Emblem, Drysdale, Global Founders Capital, Yellow; Andromeda Forerunner Ventures, Innovation Victoria, Trampoline Ventures; Bedrock Titanium Ventures. Remanence and Intergrid investor names come from a fetch of the candidate article itself (stored text was thin), so the validator will not find them in the stored corpus. Unresolved or weak: NeuxMind.AI HQ unknown; Codex HQ (New York) rests on a startup directory listing and its PBC form; Andromeda Robotics HQ set to Melbourne although the round surfaced via an SEC Form D, so it may count as US; Tendrils round type "Seed" comes from secondary coverage, the TFN article does not name the round; Fairly round type and investors not found; Vudoo currency is probably AUD; Shenzhen Boyin AI check not done (lookup budget exhausted).
